rule.text: Keep the original surface (lead A own-sheet GrowPatch resampled on the claim-frame carrier grid; w074big where A is absent) everywhere, EXCEPT where (i) the two independent cloud spiral-fit copies of winding w074 (lanes z8400 and z8400o; above the line also lane z9900) agree within 4 vx with each other, (ii) the m7-surface-prediction sheet tracker agrees with them within 4 vx, and (iii) the original is more than 4 vx away from them. There the surface is moved onto the m7-tracked sheet. Mask: opened 1 cell, grown 1 cell, components >= 0.5 mm2, feathered over 0.35 mm. ADOPTED region: only the component whose centroid lies in the pre-registered region "line row right" (u +12..+30, |v| <= 4 mm): 85.9 mm2 at the right end of the line (u ~+14..+23).
rule.drivers: CT-derived geometry only: spiral-fit surfaces, the published m7 surface prediction and the CT. No ink map, no label, no tracing was used to define, place or choose the touch-up.
rule.code: code/surface/touchup.py inputs inputs V5R_rightend 12,30,-4,4 OUT ; then reflatten.py (below)

recto_fibre_score.method: Q5 recto score H per ~1 mm tile of CT layer 20: +1 = structure along u (the recto fibre family the writing runs along); P1 recto.py
recto_fibre_score.note: compared V0 vs V5 on the same (un-re-flattened) grid; H is metric-dependent

independent_sheet_identity.surfaces: lane z8400 w074, lane z8400o w074, m7 track, R1 (a second GrowPatch)

seam.outside: p90 25.25 (original 23.24): the chevron fold below the group

geometry_before.note: where the touch-up lands, A sits ~9 vx off the sheet that both lane copies and the m7 track agree on (97-99 % within 4 vx)

reflattening.method: fold-weighted ARAP (local/global, cotangent weights) over u -31..+31 x v -21..+16 mm; triangles whose 3-D/flat area ratio is outside [0.8, 1.25] weighted 0.02; Procrustes-aligned to the old (u, v) on the line band u -10..+8, |v| <= 2.5; resampled on the same carrier grid

no_harm_measurement.note: measurement only (the papyrologist tracing, held out, warped through the exact 3-D correspondence); not used to adopt

reproduction.check: lane I2 re-ran touchup.py + reflatten.py from the shipped intermediate arrays (code/surface/inputs): x/y/z.tif and reflatten.json byte-identical to the claim mesh
